description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named CheckoutController, responsible for handling checkout-related HTTP endpoints, specifically for creating an order from cart items. It integrates with a service CreateOrderFromCartFlow to perform business logic, and exposes an API endpoint at /api/checkout/orders with relevant documentation and security annotations.

classes.name: CheckoutController
classes.description: REST API controller for checkout process, handling order creation from cart items.

methods.name: createOrderFromCart
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create an order from cart data, validates input, invokes business flow, and returns order status.
